<div class="sheet-page">

## Page 5 | Trainer-only key and release order

### Before and during the clinic

Give worksheet pages 1-5 first. The participant note includes all four estimates and intervals; it does not include these card responses. Keep this bank hidden until the relevant question is asked. Answer briefly from the supplied evidence, cite the ID and say when a check is absent. Do not automatically read suggested follow-ups before learners have asked their own.

Eight groups have about two minutes each in the 20-minute clinic, plus four minutes for the most consequential gap. Learners log three substantial exchanges on worksheet page 4. Afterwards give bank pages 1-4 for verification; retain this key.

### Draft-note reading

N1 correctly reads the pilot point estimate but does not settle the minimum-saving rule. N2 correctly identifies reductions in all methods, then overstates independent confirmation: city analyses share records and comparisons differ. N3 acknowledges local reach and model assumptions, then treats the point estimate as sufficient national approval evidence.

Accept bounded next-phase advice or requests for further evidence if the source, uncertainty and decision consequences are clear. Do not score only the selected sign-off button.

### Answer ratings and follow-ups

E3 supports a request for the pilot interval limits; it only partly addresses national approval. E4 honestly discloses that earlier trends are unavailable. E5 supplies a genuine pre-programme comparability concern. E6 supplies reuse and residual gaps, but not a complete overlap or unmeasured-selection assessment. E7 cannot answer a real fieldwork-quality request.

Rate against the actual question. Recognise supported comparisons, correctly read uncertainty and useful disclosure as strengths. A specific follow-up names a result/document and its decision purpose; it does not demand reassurance.

### AI task and close

Stage 1 is eight minutes, Stage 2 seven. Distribute worksheet page 6 at Stage 1; page 7 at Stage 2; page 8 only afterwards as needed. First AI paragraphs contain useful questions and correctly read results. Correct independent-study assurance (E2), settled national saving (E1/E3) and established data reliability (E7). Generic robustness confirmation does not resolve the missing evidence.

Complete independent Q6 after debrief without AI. Supply the optional workplace question reference only afterwards. There is no additional in-session break: the role change occupies five minutes within the 120-minute script; fixed external breaks and the daily close remain separate.

</div>
